create_3d_boxes: create a BaseInstance3DBoxes object from a tensor of N x 7 box coordinates with yaw
calculate_3d_iou_overlaps: calculate the 3D IoU overlap matrix between two sets of BaseInstance3DBoxes
check_boxes_in_range: check which 3D boxes fall within a given spatial range using in_range_3d
translate_and_scale_boxes: translate 3D boxes by a vector and scale their dimensions with a factor
concatenate_and_clone_boxes: concatenate multiple BaseInstance3DBoxes lists into one or clone an existing box set
